details: Package @sxm-web/client-sdk-core version 0.1.0 was examined and no behaviors consistent with supply-chain attack were observed. No install-time or import-time code execution, no credential or environment reads, no outbound exfiltration to attacker-controlled destinations, no silent-relay of caller data, no hardcoded third-party credentials, and no obfuscated or dynamically-fetched payloads were identified in the shipped contents.
